get_enum: enumerate an iterable and prepend each element with its index position
get_page_data: get a paginated view of source, reference, and hypothesis data with optional metrics and sorting
filter_data: filter source or reference text data by a query string and return matching indices
sort_data: sort data indices by random, reference length, source length, alphabetical, or metric value
visualize_alignment: visualize source, reference, and hypothesis text with word-level alignment rendering
